script.text: Yuya and the Lancers were teleported to Heartland City in the Xyz Dimension. They soon ran into Kite Tenjo fighting Obelisk Force.
The people of Heartland lived in peace… 'til the day Duel Academy struck!
They invaded from the Fusion Dimension without warning. An invasion masterminded by the leader of Duel Academy – the Professor.
On the day Heartland City fell, we lost family, friends… everything…
But I'll keep fighting and make Duel Academy pay for what they did to my home!
Gwa!
I can't believe you turned them into cards.
They got what they deserved. They're from Duel Academy! My sworn enemies!
But not even my worst enemy deserves anything so awful! Imagine being trapped inside a card? That's horrible!
I don't know who you are and I don't care. I'm getting rid of you all right here, right now.
Kite Tenjo is one of the best – if not THE best – in all of Heartland.
But he's acting differently than before. The Kite I knew always had a smile on his face. Now all I sense is rage… A rage so intense that it's consumed him completely.
If you dare oppose me, you must be from Duel Academy!
No, I swear I'm not!
Yuya, listen to me. In your duel with Jack Atlas, you were able to really get through to him.
But you must realize that's because you both were working toward the same objective.
The same objective?
Yes. You both wanted peace to prevail in New Domino City. But Kite is so angry that he's not fighting for peace – he's fighting for revenge. It's impossible to get through to him.
Remember what you said: "Use your power to keep the world entertained and smiling." And that's exactly what I intend to do. Yuto, just sit back and enjoy the show!
Let's duel!
